Edgeline Planners @ IMM Mall
Advertiser: Edgeline Planners
Started: 30 Apr 2026
Can a high-end sanctuary actually be dog-friendly? Most luxury
homes sacrifice comfort for style, but for this River Valley
sanctuary, designer Jay utilized Material Logic to create a
masterpiece that welcomes three French Bulldogs without losing
its Quiet Luxury soul. The journey begins with
vertical-slatted American Walnut that draws the eye upward to
create height and rhythm, seamlessly leading into a
low-profile sectional designed to host the whole family
without breaking the room’s architectural flow. This is the
true essence of Song Chi (松弛感)— a home that breathes with you.
From the precision of the recessed lighting to the tactile
warmth of the wood grain, every detail is refined for the
modern working couple who refuses to choose between elegance
and their pets. Planning a renovation? Comment "RENO" below.
